fomod.Name: BF UBE Support
fomod.Author: crajjjj
fomod.Description: Beeing Female NG add-on: UBE custom-race support. Assigns the carried baby sling to each UBE race and gives grown children a matching adult base (from the bundled Adult Pack) so they mature reliably. Requires Beeing Female NG and the UBE race plugin (UBE_AllRace.esp).
